name: skillset
description: Portable personalization layer for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Teach Codex when to use your portable skill store.
interface.longDescription: Skillset keeps reusable agent preferences in a canonical store and mirrors them into connected coding agents. This plugin routes Codex to the existing sks CLI for capture, tailoring, inspection, and repair.
defaultPrompt: Remember this as a reusable skill.
Tailor my skills from recent sessions.
